sources.title: NadavSalem/Titanius-1.1-88m-base-fp16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Titanius-1.1 is an experimental decoder-only base language model. This release is the final checkpoint of a 2-billion-token base pretraining run, saved at 30,518 optimizer steps.

sources.title: NadavSalem/Titanius-1.1-88m-sft-fp16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The repository's "88m" label counts unique trainable parameters. The input embedding and output projection share one weight matrix. PyTorch lists that shared tensor under both state-dictionary keys, but both keys refer to the same storage. The uploaded FP16 checkpoint contains model weights and inference metadata only. Optimizer and other training state were removed.

sources.title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-Zero, a model trained via large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) without supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as a preliminary step, demonstrated remarkable performance on reasoning. With RL, DeepSeek-R1-Zero naturally emerged with numerous powerful and interesting reasoning behaviors.

sources.title: Half-precision floating-point format - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Half precision (sometimes called FP16 or float16) is a binary floating-point computer number format that occupies 16 bits (two bytes in modern computers) in computer memory.
